Per-promote guard for the motion_graphics_gen seam — the deterministic branded motion-graphics video source (the code-driven, zero-cost sibling of ai_video_gen). A promo run with a motion_graphics config block makes motion_graphics_gen actually drive video_production_service POST /api/record/animation: it frame-steps the `pipeline_story` HTML template into a real MP4 per item. motion_graphics_gen depends only on promo_script, so pause_after_stages:[motion_graphics_gen] runs promo_analyze + promo_script + the live render, then pauses BEFORE the heavy tail (promo_narrate TTS + promo_render compile) — the same cheap-guard pattern promo-shotlist-url uses with site_capture. Two static items (l-001/l-002) prove the stage produced one clip per item (>=2 distinct clips[].id, each keyed to its line_id) with a real fetchable video_url republished to the artifact store — a green `paused` alone would not catch a regression where the renderer silently returned no clip or an unfetchable ACG-relative URL. duration_ms/fps/resolution are trimmed so the live render stays well inside the deadline (the FULL render→compile→MP4 path is covered by the other promo scenarios). The line_id→shot join is exercised by render, which this scenario deliberately pauses before.

FLOOR PINNED, NOT RE-SIZED (recorded 2026-09-03). `clips[].id` / `clips[].line_id >= 2` were flagged as fragile because MEASURED over a 90-day window of completed `stage_outputs` the distinct count is min = max = 2 (n=4) -- floor exactly ON the observed minimum, with a sample too thin to size anything from honestly. n=4 is the reason to PIN rather than guess a number: the count here is NOT LLM-chosen at all, it is authored -- `run.config_overrides.motion_graphics.items` names exactly 2 items (l-001, l-002) and the deterministic template renderer emits one clip per item. min = max = 2 over 4 runs is that determinism showing, not a coincidence, and it is why the right answer was never 'lower it to 1'. tests/test_e2e_scenario_contracts.py now derives the pin from the authored `items` list and requires both floors to EQUAL it.
